scope: Production-candidate lk2nd installed as the Fx0 boot-partition prefix; boot and recovery entry qualified with the owner present

installed.lk2nd: fx0-lk2nd integration/fx0-rawboot b106e16 built with LK2ND_EXTLINUX=0 and without LK2ND_FORCE_FASTBOOT (version string fx0-rawboot-prep)
installed.replaces: forced-fastboot development build a3d4ac88... (fx0-fd380ac6); differs by the single extlinux-option commit
installed.method: installed lk2nd fastboot 'flash lk2nd' (0x80000 partition window)
installed.readback: prefix equals the candidate; raw boot image and every byte after 512 KiB unchanged; 496 bytes of block padding after the image changed (past the header-declared image and trailer)

results.unattended_boot: fastboot reboot -> stock aboot -> new lk2nd -> raw boot-deploy image -> Nura running in 82 s with taint 0, no fastboot stop
results.reboot_to_bootloader: NOT working (corrected): a repeat 'systemctl reboot --reboot-argument=bootloader' with no key held rebooted straight into Nura. The single earlier stop in fastboot after 27 s was most likely the owner still holding Volume Down from the previous step. LG aboot runs first and passes lge.bootreason=0x0, consistent with it consuming the IMEM restart reason before lk2nd reads it. Remote fastboot entry therefore needs Volume Down (or a future lk2nd/aboot hand-off of the reason).
results.cold_power_key_boot: owner: power off, USB unplugged, Power -> Nura/Sxmo by itself; PON reason 0x80 (KPDPWR), no warm-reset reason, taint 0, running
results.cold_volume_down_entry: owner: Volume Down + Power from off -> lk2nd fastboot menu, no LG factory-reset prompt; LG passed lge.bootreason=0xffffffff; log has no forced-fastboot line; fastboot continue -> Nura taint 0
results.stock_fallback: power-off + Volume Up + USB -> stock fastboot remains (LAF cleared), exercised in the factory-stock rehearsal

consequences: lk2nd no longer reads extlinux: the extlinux menu, its fallback-native16 entry and the filesystem rescue entry are not reachable; the standalone rescue stays available by fastboot boot
boot-deploy's raw image is now the only boot path; an interrupted update is recovered with Volume Down entry and fastboot flash/boot of a known-good image
host test scripts must request the bootloader explicitly instead of relying on forced fastboot
open: host-triggered fastboot entry: LG aboot consumes the IMEM restart reason; investigate the PON spare register or an lk2nd hand-off

cmdline_cleanup.change: /etc/kernel-cmdline.d/50-device-qcom-msm8226.conf overrides the device package fragment with earlycon, console=ttyMSM0,115200 and cma=256m, dropping msm.allow_vram_carveout=1 and msm.vram=192m (obsolete since the r7 GPU IOMMU)
cmdline_cleanup.result: mkinitfs rewrote the raw image at the offset; unattended reboot in 72 s; command line has neither parameter; taint 0; no display/GPU errors; GLES2 Sxmo session active on the render node; memory unchanged; owner: display and touch normal
